# A rock poking out of the snow, 0.8 m, with snow on its top. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.922 0.420 0.435 --no-slot
material new Snow --base-color 1.000 0.965 0.827 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.42 --location 0 0 0.12 --rotation 20 10 35
scale 1.2 0.9 0.8
apply --scale
material assign Rock
active Rock
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.6"
material assign Snow
mode object
shade flat
export rock.glb
